run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956


improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let zsh users load ripgrep completions with `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` by registering `_rg` via `compdef` instead of calling it at source time, and document that in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Met — sourcing after `compinit` registers `_rg` for `rg` without the issue's `_arguments` error; the TAB step could not be exercised without a built `rg`.
summary.coverage: Both changed files and the full committed range reviewed; scratch zsh 5.8.1 runs covered the new dispatch branch. `ci/test-complete` and `cargo` were unavailable.
check_details: Reviewer-executed scratch zsh runs at the reviewed head, outside the clone: sourcing after `compinit` (via `source <(...)`, `eval`, and from inside a function) leaves `_comps[rg]=_rg` with no error; sourcing before `compinit` prints `command not found: _arguments`; the pre-change file reproduces the issue's `_arguments:comparguments` error; a `ci/test-complete`-style `_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1` subshell source still prints the argument specs.
Unavailable: `ci/test-complete` and `cargo build`/`cargo test` (no built `rg`, no vendored registry). The list-args path was traced by scratch run instead.

findings.title: State that the source line must follow compinit
findings.trigger: A reader adds the new `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` line to `.zshrc` above `compinit`, as many setups order it.
findings.impact: `compdef` is undefined, so the script falls through to `_rg "$@"` at source time and prints `command not found: _arguments` on every shell start, with no completion registered.
findings.change: Add a sentence after the snippet saying it belongs after `compinit` has run, and that the `fpath` line above must precede `compinit` too.

findings.title: Drop the `$ ` prompt from the `.zshrc` snippet
findings.trigger: A reader copies the block that the text says to add to `$HOME/.zshrc`, which begins with the shell prompt `$ `.
findings.impact: The pasted line fails on every shell start with `command not found: $`, so no completion is loaded. The neighbouring `fpath=(...)` snippet correctly has no prompt.
findings.change: Change the line to `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` without the leading `$ `.

observations.fact: The sentence "easier to setup, is generally slower" is missing a subject and uses the noun `setup` as a verb.
The clone holds an untracked `.mcp.json` that is outside the committed range and was not reviewed.

requirements.evidence: `crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:441-446`; scratch run after `compinit`: no error, `_comps[rg]=_rg`; base file reproduces the error.

requirements.source: pr-body/"you can dynamically source completions in zsh"
requirements.evidence: `source` and `eval` after `compinit` both register `_rg`; sourcing before `compinit` still errors (finding `FAQ.md/source-before-compinit`).
An interactive TAB completion needs a built `rg` and a pty; registration through `compdef` was verified instead.
